## Template component tag metadata

The `{% comp %}` tag accepts optional metadata arguments alongside component
props and HTML attributes. These metadata values are exposed in the rendered
component template as `component` and `component_context`, and are also recorded
in the component registry render history for diagnostics and HTMX fragment
routing.

Use `fragment_name` for fragment identifiers. Aliases such as `fragment`,
`fragment_slug`, and `fragment_key` are intentionally rejected.

```django
{% load components %}
{% comp "components/cards/page.html" page=page source="pages" requested_by=request.path fragment_name="page_card" %}
{% comp "components/fragments/messages.html" messages=messages fragment_name="messages" %}
```
